revised_prompt:
Create a clean high-resolution conference-ready systems diagram on a white background, landscape layout, crisp vector style, blue/gray palette with amber approval nodes, highly legible English text. Title at top: "Human Review and Resumability".

Show a single stage workflow centered horizontally with arrows and boxed nodes:
Stage Execution -> checkpoint artifact -> interrupt(...) -> Human Review -> Approve or Reject.

Use a paused/hand-off visual at interrupt(...), with a small artifact box labeled "checkpoint artifact".

On the Approve branch: from Human Review to a highlighted amber decision node "Approve" leading to a box labeled exactly: "Command(resume={approved: true})" then an arrow to a box "Next Stage".

On the Reject branch: from Human Review to an amber decision node "Reject" leading to a box labeled exactly: "Command(resume={approved: false, feedback: ...})" then a curved arrow looping back to "Stage Execution".

Add a lower section beneath the graph showing persistent storage: a gray box labeled exactly "Checkpointer" with the file path underneath or inside it: ".agent-state/langgraph-checkpoints.pkl". Next to it show a gray storage box labeled exactly "TaskRun JSON / Session JSON" and a small adjacent label "Artifact Manifest".

Include a callout annotation with an arrow pointing to the paused state saying: "Resumes from paused state, not from scratch".

Make all labels in English, concise, and readable. Use clean alignment, subtle shadows, thin connector arrows, and a professional publication-quality systems figure aesthetic.
original_prompt:
Create a clean high-resolution human-in-the-loop diagram for a research agent platform.

Style: conference-ready systems figure, white background, crisp vector boxes, blue/gray palette with amber approval nodes, landscape layout, highly legible.

Title: "Human Review and Resumability"

Show a single stage with the following sequence:
Stage Execution -> checkpoint artifact -> interrupt(...) -> Human Review -> Approve or Reject.

If approve: show Command(resume={approved: true}) continuing to the next stage.
If reject: show Command(resume={approved: false, feedback: ...}) looping back to the same stage.

Show the persistent checkpointer under the graph with label ".agent-state/langgraph-checkpoints.pkl" and the state store with label "TaskRun JSON / Session JSON".
Add a callout that the graph resumes from the paused state, not from scratch.
Include exact labels: interrupt(...), Command(resume=...), Checkpointer, TaskRun JSON, Artifact Manifest.
All labels in English. Keep text concise and readable.
